newsitem.title: UK: Bass eyes First Leisure bid -- report.
newsitem.headline: Bass eyes First Leisure bid -- report.

text.p: British brewing and leisure group Bass Plc may be mulling a 650 million pound ($1 billion) bid for bingo and disco operator First Leisure Corp Plc, the Sunday Times reported.
The newspaper said First Leisure was a vulnerable target, particularly because its share price had languished since former Channel Four boss Michael Grade took over as executive chairman in June.
Market rumours have also linked Bass's name to a possible bid for Ladbroke Group Plc after the British government blocked Bass' buy of the Carlsberg-Tetley brewing group, the paper said.
Bass' shares closed down 6.0 pence at 826.5 on Friday, while First Leisure firmed 7.0 pence to 312.5.
